title: Add easy orbit collection workflow helper
objective: Add a simple user-facing helper script and docs for the flashlight orbit workflow: teleop to save an orbit JSON, then render videos for multiple light settings while preserving scene-light intensity scale and fixed-exposure controls.
instructions: User asked: 'how do I generate and render an orbit path... first teleop and generate an orbit json and then render with different light settings... create a script/command to run this easily... new ambient light intensity (scene) and exposure changes to work there'.
Add a small shell helper under examples/flashlight, preferably a generic run_orbit_workflow.sh or similarly clear name, with at least teleop and render subcommands. Keep it simple and readable.

Default the helper to cafeteria_500sqft_v2 map, examples/flashlight/orbit_spec.json, a checked-in light settings JSON, and examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output unless overridden by environment variables or flags.

Ensure helper commands pass through --scene-light-intensity-scale and fixed exposure behavior. Include --disable-auto-exposure explicitly for clarity even though it is the default. Also pass the current small-room flashlight profile: --intensity 1500, --attenuation-radius 450, --inner-cone-angle 8, --outer-cone-angle 20, --indirect-lighting-intensity 0, unless overridden cleanly.

Add or update README docs to show exact commands: teleop, render, and where videos land. Explain that scene-light intensity scale controls ambient/fixture scene lights at launch, while light settings JSON controls the co-located flashlight per rendered video.
If adding a light settings JSON, include at least three clear settings such as flashlight_off, flashlight_low, flashlight_on or comparable names.
Run lightweight validation: shell syntax check, Python parse/help checks if relevant, and existing orbit validation tests in spear-env.
constraints: No Git operations and no commits.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket with files changed, exact user commands, tests run, and any limitations.
definition_of_done: User can run one command to teleop/save orbit JSON and one command to render videos with multiple light settings using scene-light scale and fixed exposure.
